gaps.explanation: p7 Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Net Position - Proprietary Funds: detail[] has the operating revenues of the four fund columns (Sanitation 31,564 + Water 129,475 + Sewer 72,843 + Wellhead Protection 9,490 = 243,372 = printed Total operating revenues). The NONOPERATING REVENUES are printed only in the Total column: Grant income 1,657,258 and Interest income 709 (Total nonoperating revenues 1,657,967 = gap). The Statement of Activities p2 assigns the grant to Water (Capital Grants and Contributions 1,657,258 on the Water row) and the interest to the Business-Type Activities column only (Investment earnings 709). Check: 243,372 + 1,657,258 + 709 = 1,901,339 = statement total.
